defect: The native grab admission flag received mirror_x, treating a valid leading-foot stance with bit 0x20 set as unknown. All grab requests were rejected after this stance change.

source_mechanism.translation: Swap physical trigger hands and negate horizontal family selectors when mirror_x is false. Keep vertical selectors. Authored fingerflip transition X was already mirrored by playback. Foot settings retain the existing original anatomical convention.

results: Physical RT produced LeftHand intent, FS family 1, detail 6.
Physical LT produced RightHand intent, BS family 2, detail 1.
Physical RS down plus RT produced Crail family 5, detail 18.
Physical RS down plus LT produced Nose family 6, detail 22 with original tailbone selector tweak.

Physical RS negative X plus RT produced Stale family 7, detail 28; LT produced Weddle family 8, detail 29.
